title: From Stories to Equations
summary: Ages, consecutive numbers, perimeters, coins and fares: write the equation, solve it, check it makes sense.

ib.note: Modelling real problems with equations builds MYP Criterion D

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Linear Equations in One Variable
Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 7: Finding the Unknown

objectives: I can define a variable and write an equation from a story.
I can solve the equation and interpret the answer.
I can check that the answer makes sense in the context.
misconceptions: The first number in a story always goes first in the equation.
If the maths works, the answer must be sensible.
You don't need to say what the letter stands for.
